label: Стать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for стать (to become).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Стану' is the perfective future of стать; since the verb is perfective, the simple present-tense form already carries future meaning. 'Хорошим врачом' takes the instrumental case after стать.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Станешь' is the ты-form with the -ешь ending of the first conjugation. 'Настоящим мастером' is instrumental, the case стать always governs for the new state.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Станет' is the он-form ending in -ет. The instrumental 'известным писателем' marks the role he will grow into.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Станем' shows the мы-ending -ем. 'Настоящими друзьями' is instrumental plural, the predicate of становления.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Станут' closes the future paradigm with the -ут ending. Here стать pairs with a comparative, 'сильнее', meaning to grow stronger.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Стал' is the masculine singular past of perfective стать. The aspect stresses a completed change of state; 'известным' is instrumental.

missions.phrase: Она стала врачом в прошлом году.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Стала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Врачом' is instrumental, and 'в прошлом году' fixes the completed transformation in time.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Стали' is the plural past ending in -и. Here стать governs comparatives 'короче' and 'холоднее' instead of an instrumental noun.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Стань' is the informal command of perfective стать. 'Взрослым человеком' stays in the instrumental, the standard case for the resulting state.

missions.phrase: Я хочу стать лучше, чем вчера.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Infinitive after a modal. 'Хочу' governs the bare infinitive 'стать'. The imperfective partner is становиться; here the perfective infinitive points to one decisive change.
